desk-look no longer redraws the whole screen every 3 seconds while Claude sits idle after an answer.

- desk-look re-reads the Omarchy theme every 3 seconds; even when nothing changed, writing the same value back made the engine redraw everything that reads it, costing 40–50 ms of CPU every 3 seconds
- Values desk-look re-reads (theme, context usage, images, runs, tasks, agents, agent detail) are now compared first and written only when they change
- A theme change is still picked up within 3 seconds

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
